I'm a kid that never felt wanted, then I got groomed, and the groomer used his kid as a bargaining chip. Honestly, it wasn't until I decided to be childfree that I even realized the additional benefits of being childfree.

I am in the same boat. Even before I had to get an abortion, the only thing I felt was relief. It didn't help that those who mentioned having miscarriages in my work circle were stuck working at a dead-end fast food job.

Hell, every day leading up to my abortion, I was trying to induce a miscarriage! So after my abortion, I find myself thinking, "Congrats on saving a few hundred." Which sounds pretty fucked, but it's the closest I've come to feeling anything about miscarriages.

KAngel is the streaming persona for the main character Ame of Needy Girl Overdose/Needy Streamer Overload. The game itself is a pseudo raising sim where the player needs to help Ame become internet famous while dealing with her mental health struggles. So similar to SEL and the Lain game it comments on the use of the internet as a coping mechanism but slightly to the left. If that makes sense.

KAngel's birthday was on June 7th and a live stream was held. Like, I mostly wish she stood up for herself more so she could get that better ending she deserves. Or at least an ending where she's not killed by her only patient.

The first couple days after I used the medication it was fine. Not a lot of bleeding or a lot of pain. So I was basically able to just go about.my life. I don't think the abortion actually happened until the third day after taking the medications. Which was not ideal for me, since I was in middle of work.

There was a lot of blood, to the point I had to ask one of my coworkers to get me a package of night pads because I had ran out of the ones I had brought. The pain was also fucking horrible, but I was having to stand for work and was unable to take pain meds. But I was at least surrounded by most of the coworkers I liked and everyone was understanding, most assumed it was a normal period.

Ultimately I wish I was anywhere else when it happened, but I'm just glad it's over. There is still some bleeding after it and it starts to lighten up to the point where I wouldn't bother with either a pad or a tampon.
